text: XXXV. 1. Pañc'ime bhikkhave dāne ānisaṃsā. Katame pañca? 2. Bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, santo sappurisā bhajanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, gihidhammā anapeto hoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dāne ānisaṃsā ti. Dadamāno piyo hoti sataṃ dhammaṃ anukkamaṃ santo naṃ sadā bhajanti saññatā brahmacārayo. Te tassa dhammaṃ desenti sabbadukkhāpanūdanaṃ yaṃ so dhammaṃ idhaññāya parinibbāti anāsavo ti.
